sanitization.primaryUseCaseHint: Rules mainly protect chat call history, logs and tracing records that contain user data. Live gateway responses are not masked by default; admin /api/** and AI paths are excluded.
sanitization.enableConfirmMessage: Once enabled, every matched request or response runs regex matching and text rewriting. Large response bodies, complex patterns or high QPS increase CPU usage and response latency; load-test with real traffic in staging first, then start from a minimal rule set, and avoid regexes prone to catastrophic backtracking.
sanitization.enabledPerformanceWarning: Enabled: may affect performance (regex matching + text rewriting). Evaluate latency for large response bodies or high QPS.
sanitization.testSamplePlaceholder: Paste chat content with phone/email etc.
